Hollywood is supposedly terrified of AI taking over filmmaking.

But here's the problem: Hollywood has been using software, algorithms, simulations, machine learning, massive server farms, and increasingly automated VFX workflows for decades. So where exactly do we draw the line between art and AI slop?

In this episode, Caya goes back to the CGI that made him want to study Digital Animation: Davy Jones in Pirates of the Caribbean.

We break down
